paragraphs: Tom and Ben sit on Ben's new balcony. Ben reads a comic. "It's a funny comic," says Ben. "Can I read it too?" asks Tom. "Wait, I'm on the last page." Tom looks down at the ground. "Look! That's Sam in the playground," he says. "What's he doing?" asks Ben. The boys can see the whole street from the balcony.

Tom has a ball in his hand. "Let's throw it to Sam!" he says. "No, Tom! It's a long way down," says Ben. But the ball falls from Tom's hand. It goes down, down, down. Tom is very sad. Sam sees it and runs. He catches the ball and dances on the grass. "We're sorry, Sam!" shouts Tom. "Please bring it up!"

"OK, I'm coming!" says Sam. Tom looks at his phone. "Dad can drive here at five o'clock," he says. "What's your address, Ben?" "It's twenty-five Park Street," says Ben. Tom writes it in an email and sends it to Dad. Then Sam comes in with the ball. "Here you are," he says and laughs. Now the three boys read the comic. At five o'clock Dad's car stops in the street. "Bye, Ben! Thanks, Sam!" says Tom.
text.summary: Tom visits Ben's new home. Their ball falls from the balcony, and Sam dances with it on the ground before he brings it up.
